tasks.title: Q1: pricing bug
tasks.brief: Read-only benchmark question. Do not edit any file. Read /tmp/vcmp/w/t1/src/pricing.ts. Name the function that has a bug and give the one-line fix (at most 3 lines). Report only the answer.
tasks.result:
## Outcome
Done. The buggy function is `applyDiscount`, at `/tmp/vcmp/w/t1/src/pricing.ts:5-8`.

## Findings
- `applyDiscount` (line 7) computes `Math.round(cents * (1 - pct))`, but the comment on line 6 says `pct` is a whole number (10 means 10%). So a 10% discount is applied as `1 - 10 = -9`, which multiplies the price by -9.

Fix (one line, line 7):
```ts
return Math.round(cents * (1 - pct / 100));
```

## Verification
- Read the full file (12 lines). The only function that uses `pct` is `applyDiscount`. `subtotal` and `tax` are not affected.
- I did not run the code or any tests, since the task was read-only.

## Open issues
- None. The fix assumes every caller passes whole-number percentages, as the comment states. I did not check callers, because the file was the only thing in scope.
